avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces buprenorphine levels; may precipitate withdrawal symptoms
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort or avoid buprenorphine; counsel patient before initiating either agent

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk; potentiates CNS depression and respiratory depression
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; recommend alternative anxiolytic or herbal option

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root (high dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and respiratory depression risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative sleep aid with lower CNS interaction

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase buprenorphine levels; typically minimal effect
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for opioid toxicity signs; document use in medical record

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet effects; no direct pharmacokinetic interaction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor if patient has bleeding risk; generally safe at standard doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases buprenorphine bioavailability and levels
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products entirely; educate patient on hidden sources (some juices, supplements)

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase buprenorphine absorption; sublingual formulation less affected
caution_foods.action: Consistent timing relative to food intake recommended; counsel on standardized administration

caution_foods.name: Caffeine (high intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate CNS effects; no direct metabolic interaction
caution_foods.action: Advise moderation; monitor for increased sedation or jitteriness

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of opioid toxicity (sedation, respiratory depression, pinpoint pupils) especially with CYP3A4 inhibitors. Counsel patients on strict avoidance of grapefruit and CNS depressants; assess for withdrawal symptoms if CYP3A4 inducers are initiated.
